image_description: A vintage black Smith-Corona typewriter sitting on a wooden surface. The image focuses on the keyboard area, showing round keys with gold lettering and a long, rectangular space bar at the bottom center. The brand name 'Smith - Corona' is visible in white text on the front panel, and 'SILENT' is printed on the paper guide.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated rectangular key spanning the full width of the bottom keyboard row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is elongated and rectangular, but it does NOT span the 'full width' of the bottom row; it is flanked by modifier keys (Shift Lock, Margin Release) on both sides.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Length is dramatically greater than any other key, roughly ten times the width of a standard letter key.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is significantly longer than the circular letter keys, appearing to be approximately 6-8 times the diameter of a single key, which satisfies the 'dramatically greater' criteria even if not exactly 10x.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface is flat or slightly concave.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar appears to have a flat, smooth surface consistent with typewriter design.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Underside connects to a long stabilizer bar mechanism.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside and internal mechanical linkage are completely occluded by the keycap and the camera angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Label is typically blank with no printed character.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is solid black with no visible letters or symbols printed on it.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Positioned centrally between modifier keys on the bottom row.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is clearly centered at the bottom of the keyboard layout, between the left and right side keys.
The key exhibits a non-glossy, smooth texture consistent with matte plastic or painted metal typical of vintage typewriters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Typically white, black, or gray to match keyboard color scheme.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The space bar is black, matching the body of the typewriter and contrasting with the gold lettering on other keys.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Part of a standard computer or typewriter keyboard.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly integrated into a QWERTY typewriter keyboard assembly.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific identification of the space bar within the context of a vintage typewriter vs modern keyboard.
To verify the physical separation of the space bar from the chassis and ensure no melting/fusion artifacts at the edges.
To audit the legibility and structural integrity of the 'Smith - Corona' and 'SILENT' text, checking for AI gibberish.
To assess overall image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture anomalies in the metal/plastic surfaces.

focus_areas: Edge definition of the space bar against the dark chassis
Geometric regularity of the round keys surrounding the space bar
Legibility and font consistency of the brand text
Reflections and highlights on the metallic parts for physical plausibility
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'full width' checkpoint. The Router marked it false because modifier keys exist. Verify if this strict interpretation is correct for the 'space bar' class definition or if 'spanning the main typing area' is sufficient. Also, scrutinize the round keys for any slight elliptical distortions or inconsistent spacing which are common AI artifacts in typewriter generations.
